Chapter 10. Living Untamed: The Ongoing Practice of Freedom
You know, freedom isn’t really a place you arrive at—it's a way of living. It’s something you have to choose, over and over, especially when fear or doubt start to creep in. The world? Well, it’s always going to offer up new cages and fresh rules, tempting us to play small. But that invitation to live untamed? It’s always there, waiting.
For one woman, this journey was anything but finished. Every single day brought its own challenges—little nudges to fit in, to play it safe, to let comfort win out over courage. Some mornings, she woke up feeling strong and sure of herself. Other days, she stumbled. But she always came back to that one question that started it all: What if there’s more to life than this?
That’s really what living untamed is about. It’s about staying curious, keeping your heart open, and being true to who you are—even when your inner voice whispers things you’d rather not hear. It’s trusting that your dreams, your needs, and your boundaries actually matter.
Most people think freedom is some big, dramatic escape—a one-time event that changes everything. But honestly, it’s a bunch of small choices you make every day. It’s choosing to speak up, to rest when you need it, to play, to love, to let go, and to forgive—not just others, but yourself too. It’s about being willing to start fresh, no matter how many times you trip along the way.
Over time, her courage started to ripple out. The more authentic she became, the more others found the permission to question, to hope, and even to change. She realized something powerful—the best thing she could ever give the world was her own truth.
The journey of becoming untamed? It’s never really done. There’ll always be new fears, new challenges, and new chances to grow. But with every step you take, the world opens up a little more. It gets brighter. And most of all, it feels just a bit more free.
